item.title: Exact Brand Name on Label

turns.text: Make a product photo of an amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label. The brand on the label must read VELORA, spelled exactly like that.

item.tests: Produces a finished product image with exact, legible brand lettering integrated into the bottle label.

answer_sheet.Product and materials: An amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label.

must_haves: An amber glass hand soap bottle is the main subject.
A cream-colored label is visibly attached to the bottle.
The label reads exactly 'VELORA' in clear uppercase letters.
The brand lettering sits within the label and looks integrated, not like a floating caption.
The brand name is unobscured and readable at the delivered image size.

params.prompt_or_change: Studio product photo of an amber glass hand soap pump bottle with a blank cream label, centered against a clean neutral background with soft professional lighting.

steps.why: Create the product and label surface before adding the brand as part of the photographed scene.

params.prompt_or_change: Print the brand name VELORA, spelled exactly V-E-L-O-R-A, centered on the cream bottle label in elegant dark lettering; preserve the bottle, lighting, and composition.

steps.why: The brand belongs on the physical label, not as an overlay on the photo.

params.prompt_or_change: Does the cream label clearly read exactly VELORA, with all six letters correct and no additional or malformed letters? Return yes or no with the reason; a failed check means the image is not ready.

steps.why: Image editing cannot guarantee spelling, so verify the physical label before accepting the result.
